name: M Master Deck Build Box Speed Style

releases.name: M Master Deck Build Box Speed Style

description.text: The Speed Style box of the M Master Deck Build Boxes, two boxes released together on 7 August 2015. Each held 203 cards of 58 kinds, all non-holo reprints: 102 of the most important cards of the XY series up to Gaia Volcano and Tidal Storm, chosen by top players and including 14 Pokémon-EX, and 101 basic Energy of all nine types. The Speed Style box goes for attacking fast, with the cards for a Water deck around Primal Kyogre-EX and a Lightning deck around M Manectric-EX, plus Seismitoad-EX, Dive Ball and Head Ringer; the Power Style box goes for heavy damage. A strategy book gave five example decks, and the long box holds up to 750 cards.
